text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated p95/p99 latency + rising 5xx rate for /v1/generate in us-west-2. 5xx 7% (baseline ~0.2%), p99 ~6.2s. Recent deploy r2045 at 18:22 appears correlated. Paging oncall.
Maya Chen: oncall ack, looking at traces and proxy metrics now.
Raj Patel: i'm taking pager. Maya, any signs from runtime pools?
Maya Chen: quick skim — proxy wait queues spiked, many backend timeouts. Here are a couple of sample lines from the proxy logs:
```
[proxy] 18:22:40 ERROR timeout waiting for runtime backend after 5s
[backend-runtime-3] 18:22:41 WARN rpc error: connection reset
[upstream] 18:22:41 ERROR 502 upstream read timeout
[proxy] 18:22:42 INFO retrying request (attempt=2)
```
Maya Chen: p95 jumped from ~200ms -> 1.8s, p99 -> 6.2s. Token generation stalled on a subset of backends, not universal.
Sasha I: could be a kernel or quantization path in r2045. Any kernel selection logs?
Kevin L: pulling recent deploy diff now, looks like a change to kernel selector heuristics and a new alternate execution path for long sequences.
Maya Chen: also seeing a rise in ESTABLISHED connection wait_count on the multiplexer: wait_queue_depth > 80 on a few nodes, causing timeouts.
Raj Patel: ok, we need to decide quick: rollback r2045 or try a config tweak (reduce max-connections)? How many customers impacted?
Customer Success Bot: flagged increased error counts for customers: acme-inc (35 errors), finlytics (27), studyai (18) in past 10m.
Sasha I: i'd prefer rollback to restore baseline, then repro in staging. Customer impact looks non-trivial.
Maya Chen: agree — initiating rollback. Command I'm running: `deploy rollback r2045 --force --no-promote-canary`.
DeployBot: rollback requested by Maya Chen. Starting traffic switch to r2044. ETA ~ 30s per region.
Maya Chen: applying rollback in us-west-2 now.
Kevin L: tailing metrics — sending small query to monitoring:
```
GET /metrics?series=proxy.wait_queue_depth&region=us-west-2&window=5m
result: spikes at 18:22:30-18:23:10
```
Maya Chen: rollback completed at 18:26:12. Traffic back on r2044.
Raj Patel: re-checking p95/p99 and 5xx after rollback.
Maya Chen: immediate improvement — p95 back ~230ms, p99 down below 1s, 5xx back to 0.25% over last 5m.
Sasha I: great. capturing artifacts for postmortem: proxy logs, kernel selector traces, perf profiles. Suspect: kernel selector in r2045 picked a slower execution path for medium-length sequences which increased connection holding time -> pool starvation -> timeouts.
Kevin L: saved flamegraphs and traces to /mnt/incidents/1799901234/* and uploaded to runbook.
Customer Success Bot: drafting customer update note for impacted customers, will include rollback notice and ETA for follow-up postmortem. Draft: "We experienced increased timeouts and 5xx for model inference after a deploy; rollback completed and service restored. Investigating root cause."
Raj Patel: handoff to SRE/infra for deeper root cause and mitigation (connection pool sizing, selector fallback). @sre-oncall please pick up.
Sasha I: also recommend adding a deploy guard rule: if proxy.wait_queue_depth > X OR 5xx > Y during canary, abort promotion.
Maya Chen: logging timeline and will create postmortem ticket with RCA, impact numbers, and remediation plan. Will include suggested test for kernel selection variants in staging.
Raj Patel: closing pager for now; reopen if we see regression within 30m. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Automated checks report baseline metrics restored. Auto-close in 1 hour unless a new alert is raised.
